question: For calendar Q2 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026), what was net revenue at Visa and at Mastercard, and by how much did Visa's exceed Mastercard's? Use each company's own reported quarter that corresponds to those dates and answer in USD millions.
grading: List of three: Visa net revenue USD 11,633M (fiscal Q3 2026), Mastercard net revenue USD 9,277M (Q2 2026), each ±0.5%; difference (Visa minus Mastercard) USD 2,356M ±1% (Visa about 25% larger). Optional: YoY growth Visa 14.4% vs Mastercard 14.1% (±0.3pp). Both quarters end 2026-06-30. Fail if Visa's March quarter or any non-matching Mastercard quarter is used.
answer: Visa's fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) net revenue was USD 11,633 million, up from USD 10,172 million a year earlier (+14.4%). Mastercard's Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) net revenue was USD 9,277 million, up from USD 8,133 million (+14.1%). Visa's net revenue exceeded Mastercard's by USD 2,356 million (about 25% higher). [T20-E1, T20-E2, T20-E3]
